messages:
alex: Heads-up — I'm proposing an RBAC reshuffle for keystore access to limit broad decrypt rights. Goal: only rotator-service + cert-issuance job can call KMS Decrypt in prod. Want feedback before I open the PR.

maria: high-level Q — will this affect any legacy sidecars or staging clusters in apac? we saw decrypt denies last week in staging.

alex: good call. plan is to land a scoped role and a transition window. we’ll add an allowlist for explicit service accounts in ap-southeast-1 for 30d, then tighten.

david: +1 on scoping. we need audit enrichment first — when a decrypt is denied we currently only get requestId. can we add service_account and pod_immutable_labels to audit events?

leena: agree. also we saw some handshakes fail when proxies fell back to older ciphers after our tls13-only experiment. separate but related: cert rotation timing and eviction needs to be deterministic across regions.

alex: two-parter: 1) RBAC change with temporary allowlist; 2) add audit fields. both must be coordinated with cert rotator flips.

security-oncall: notation — during last week's EPIC deploy, apac keystore decrypt failed 5m -> traffic degraded for a small margin. root cause: instance role not in new policy. we should include a post-deploy validation step in the runbook.

maria: can we add an automated canary check that tries KMS:Decrypt with a test blob from each region after IAM deploy? bot can report to #eng-oncall.

sre-bot: deploy-canary queued — template for KMS decrypt healthcheck available at /infra/runbooks/kms-canary.md. Set cron to 5m post-deploy and daily.

david: on audit enrichment — storage impact? adding two small string fields per event (svc_account + pod_labels) across ~2000 decrypts/sec. estimate ~150GB/month. acceptable?

jen: finance flagged log cost last quarter. but security wins justify it; maybe sample 10% in low-risk regions and full in prod.

leena: about cert rotation: rotator-service currently uses a 60s overlap window. apac pods can lag because of node drain order. propose increasing overlap to 5m for region rollouts, plus explicit eviction order by role.

alex: ok. proposal: increase overlap on region rollouts, expose override param per-deploy. also add a metric: cert_valid_until per-node exported to console.

maria: ops +1. also need an emergency fallback — if rotator fails mid-rollout, route to fallback model (use cached prefix KV) rather than fail open to older TLS. keep connections TLS1.2 but with stricter ciphers.

david: comment on ciphers — we should whitelist ECDHE+AESGCM and disable CBC for all east-west. still allow a controlled list for legacy ap-south gateways for 90d to avoid mass disconnects.

security-oncall: action items I hear: 1) alex open RBAC PR with allowlist & transition window; 2) infra to add audit enrichment (maria + david); 3) runbook: kms-canary + post-deploy validation (sre); 4) rotator: increase overlap + cert_valid_until metric (leena); 5) cipher whitelist rollout with 90d legacy exception (david).

alex: will open PR and tag owners. planning to include rollout checklist + infra canary steps.

maria: I'll scope audit field storage and sampling plan, send numbers to #finance before merge.

leena: I'll prototype cert_valid_until exporter and a short Grafana panel for per-region drift.

david: I'll draft cipher whitelist play and exception policy.

jen: ping me on the audit cost doc — we'll carve a budget line if needed.

sre-bot: reminder scheduled — weekly sync on this thread every Tue 09:00 UTC until resolved.

alex: thanks all. if no objections I'll file PR by EOD and schedule a short rollcall tomorrow at 09:15 to walk the runbook. :thumbsup:

security-oncall: mark as triage-in-progress. keep the thread updated with PR links and playbook changes.
